description: Pause a project — stop its work without taking anything away — or resume it. A paused project stays fully readable (board, issues, search, wiki, export) and accepts no writes from anybody, its lead and admins included, until it is resumed; reminders, schedules, agents and auto-archive leave it alone. Nothing about any issue or person changes. Only the project's lead (or its parent's, or an admin) may do either; both are written to the project's history. For a project whose work is finished, archive_project is the better word: it also takes the project off the lists.

paused.description: true to pause it, false to resume it.

reason.description: Optional, when pausing: why, in a sentence — shown on the board beside the notice. Up to 500 characters.
